senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כּוּן)to arrange, order, plan (applied to art, cmp. חָרַשׁ; to music, v. קִינָה).
to arrange a song of lamentation (ḳinah, cmp. קשר הספד, v. הֶסְפֵּד).
units: <cite ref="Gittin 58a">Gitt. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>עליה ק׳ ירמיהו וכ׳</he> on her account Jeremiah sang &c.

<cite ref="Gittin 58a">Ib.</cite> <he>ועליהן קינה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.; v. En Yaʿăḳob). Lam. R. introd. (R. Naḥman) <he>התחיל … מְקוֹנֵן עליהם איכה</he> Jeremiah began to sing Ekhah (<cite ref="Lamentations 1:1">Lam. I, 1</cite>) over them.
<cite ref="Lamentations 1:1">Ib.</cite> (R. Pinḥas) <he>הרי … מקונן עליכם קינות וכ׳</he> behold, Jeremiah will sing lamentations of seven alphabets (of) Ekhah over you.

<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:9">M. Kat. III, 9</cite> <he>אבל לא מְקוֹנְנוֹת</he> but they (the lamenting women) must not sing dirges, v. <cite ref="S01024"><he>קִינָה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="P00612"><he>עִינּוּי</he> I</cite>; a. fr.
